matrix_label: M5 why-unavailable / source-language primitive: blocked-action owner, unavailable reason, next-safe-action, failure domain, and deeper-docs path (why-unavailable) plus source-language class, fallback-state, stable ID, and citation-preserving link (source-language), with derived why-unavailable postures (blocked-by-policy/missing-permission/precondition-unmet/feature-disabled/offline-unavailable/unsupported-target), localization postures, and bounded actions

rows.scope_summary: The command-help row renders both shared surfaces so a policy-blocked command names the policy owner, the exact reason, and a request-access next step, a permission-gated command names the workspace admin and the same safe next step, and a localized help string either reads as fully localized or falls back to the source language with its stable ID and canonical citation intact — never a generic disabled state and never an unsourced paraphrase
